fact: The South Gezira locality civil registry centre (Al-Hosh office) announced it issued the first electronic birth certificate, on 17 May 2026, for a child born in August 2023, after a suspension caused by war and displacement (Al-Nawrs News).

fact: SUNA reports the Ministries of Health and Digital Transformation launched on 2026-05-11 phase one of the HMS hospital-management programme, whose integrated systems include a civil registration and vital statistics (CRVS) system, starting at Al-Nao hospital in Khartoum State and the diagnostic centre at Gedaref hospital.
